name: redpoint-ai
//overrides: shell-quote pinned to 1.11.0, the fix for GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv (CVE-2026-102422; vuln >=1.8.4 <1.11.0), which is also above the older GHSA-w7jw-789q-3m8p / GHSA-395f-4hp3-45gv line (vuln <=1.8.3). Transitive via gel, an optional peer of drizzle-orm that loads only through a drizzle-orm/gel import, which this repo never makes (it uses the bun-sqlite and postgres-js drivers). sharp forced to >=0.35.5 (bundled libvips 8.18.x) for GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj / GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c / GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w: an optional dep of next (which declares ^0.34.5), used by its /_next/image optimizer; next 16.2 runs it unchanged. @modelcontextprotocol/sdk forced to 1.32.0 for GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453 (CVE-2026-111768; a tools/call whose arguments are large enough can exhaust memory during validation, closed by the server's opt-in maxToolInputElements ceiling, which packages/mcp-rpi and packages/mcp-drh set) and CVE-2026-111767 (the SDK's tasks store, which this repo never uses); it is also above GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h (CVE-2026-104850; vuln >=1.12.0 <1.31.0, the SDK's OAuth client provider flow, which this repo never uses). apps/server and both MCP packages declare it directly, and the override also lifts shadcn's own copy (it declares ^1.26.0). hono 4.13.13 (the servers and apps/server declare it; the override lifts the MCP SDK's own copy), fast-uri 3.1.9 (GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr and others; ajv's URI parsing), qs 6.16.1, ip-address 10.7.4 and @hono/node-server 1.19.15 lift the transitive copies the MCP SDK pulls in to their fixed releases (@hono/node-server's GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f, serveStatic's double decode, is fixed only in 2.1.3, a major under the SDK's 1.x range, and is unreachable: nothing here mounts serveStatic). The server lines (RPI 7.226, DRH 7.215) also force js-yaml 4.3.2 and brace-expansion 2.1.7; this line can't: packages/skills reads SKILL.md front-matter through gray-matter, which calls js-yaml 3's safeLoad (removed in js-yaml 4), and minimatch 3 under eslint expects brace-expansion 1.

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/server/dist apps/web/.next apps/web/out .playwright-cli
scripts.postinstall: if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.fileMode false; fi
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' test && bun test scripts/
